title: 第2364章 尽在掌控静等虫皇第2363章 诛灭细作虫群越境
content_zh:
“诸位猜得不错，这批过境凶虫，正是焚灵噬金蠊。”
莫凡眸光落于大殿水镜之上，望着雪域之外铺天盖地、吞噬万物的金色虫潮，神色平静，缓缓开口解惑。
“此虫并非朕亲手培育，原产于青梧洲一处上古秘境‘绝雾虚’。
当年朕远赴青梧洲，遭郑家修士围杀追杀，意外误入秘境腹地，方才与这一族凶虫结缘。”
话音未落，莫凡随手轻挥，身前虚空泛起细密涟漪，一道狭小的空间裂缝悄然绽开。
一只通体剔透如琉璃、羽翼轻薄半透的娇小虫影自裂缝中轻盈掠出，稳稳落于莫凡肩头，正是小白。
平日里慵懒温顺、肆意休憩的小白，此刻望见水镜中漫天肆虐的金色虫潮，浑身姿态骤然一凝。
原本松弛的虫躯紧绷如弦，细小的肢足尽数收紧，澄澈的虫瞳中褪去所有娇憨，只剩浓郁的凝重与忌惮，俨然是窥见同族顶级天敌的本能戒备。
莫凡并未留意小白的异动，继续沉声向群臣道出秘辛：“想必诸位已然猜到，朕于绝雾虚中收服的这只焚灵噬金蠊，便是这一虫族的虫母之一。
如今朕麾下驯养的虫群，皆为小白一脉子嗣。”
“但绝雾虚腹地广袤、虫族繁盛，绝非仅有小白一支焚灵噬金镰族群。
秘境之中，还盘踞着这一族最为强横的焚灵噬金蠊，其虫母修为臻至中阶大圣，统御大半个绝雾虚虫潮，自号虫皇，霸道至极。”
“昔日绝雾虚设有上古界源镇压，空间稳固，纵使虫皇底蕴滔天，也只能困于秘境之内，无法踏出半步。
可郑家一众修士贪心作祟，联合各方贪婪之徒，强行盗取、剥离秘境镇界之源，彻底破掉绝雾虚封禁，致使虫皇携无尽虫潮挣脱禁锢，肆虐青梧洲，成为一方大祸。”
莫凡语气微微一顿，眸光沉肃，郑重告诫满朝文武：“尔等需谨记，焚灵噬金蠊天性凶戾、饕餮无度，极为可怖。
其甲壳坚逾神金，寻常古宝轰击难破分毫。
口器凝练精纯庚金之力，锋锐无匹，但凡蕴含灵气之物，草木生灵、修士肉身、法宝灵器、天材地宝，皆可被其瞬间啃噬殆尽、化为虚无。”
“单只凶虫已然难缠，一旦聚集成潮、铺天盖地，威势更是呈几何倍数暴涨。
数量足够之时，纵使大圣境强者深陷虫海，也难逃被啃噬身死、元神俱灭的结局！”
“此言绝非朕夸大。

早前虫皇便曾率领无尽虫潮强攻郑家悬天剑城，血战半日、威势滔天。
郑家坐拥灵界赫赫有名的大玄天剑阵，底蕴冠绝一方，方才勉强将虫潮逼退。
只是朕未曾料到，这虫皇蛰伏休整之后，竟会横跨疆域，将兵锋直指我万古帝朝！”
一番详尽阐述落下，整座万古大殿气氛骤沉，群臣心头皆压上一块重石，隐隐生出凛冽寒意。
“可恨！必然是郑家暗中作祟！”红眼双目赤红，率先怒声斥骂。
“没错！定是郑家战败怀恨，刻意泄露我青龙域情报、嫁祸我朝，以此转移虫皇仇恨！”喳喳亦是咬牙切齿，满心愤懑，“这等阴毒伎俩，实在卑劣无耻！”
震怒之余，一众朝臣纷纷上前拱手请命，神色恳切决绝。
“帝君，虫潮凶险、祸在眉睫，不可坐以待毙！”
“恳请帝君即刻调兵北上，主动迎击，镇杀虫潮、守护疆域！”
群臣心中虽对漫天虫潮心生忌惮，却无人退缩怯懦。
content_en:
"Everyone's guess is correct. These passing ferocious insects are none other than the soul-burning gold-eating cockroaches."
Mo Fan's eyes fell on the water mirror of the main hall, looking at the overwhelming golden insect tide outside the snowy area, devouring everything. His expression was calm, and he slowly opened his mouth to answer his questions.
“This insect was not cultivated by me personally. It originated from an ancient secret place in Qingwu Continent, ‘Juewuxu’.
Back then, when I went to Qingwu Continent, I was surrounded and hunted by the monks of the Zheng family. I accidentally strayed into the hinterland of the secret realm, and it was only then that I became associated with this family of ferocious insects. "
Before he finished speaking, Mo Fan waved his hand lightly, and fine ripples appeared in the void in front of him, and a small space crack quietly opened.
A petite insect figure with a body as clear as glass and thin and translucent wings flew out of the crack and landed steadily on Mo Fan's shoulder. It was Xiaobai.
Xiao Bai, who was usually lazy and docile, resting as much as he wanted, now saw the golden insect tide raging all over the sky in the water mirror, and his whole body suddenly froze.
The originally loose body of the insect was as tight as a string, and all the tiny limbs were tightened. All the charm and innocence in the clear insect pupils were gone, leaving only a strong sense of solemnity and fear, which seemed to be the instinctive vigilance of the top natural enemy of the same species.
Mo Fan did not pay attention to Xiaobai's unusual movements, and continued to tell the secret to the ministers in a deep voice: "You must have guessed that the soul-burning gold-eating cockroach that I conquered in Juewuxu is one of the mother insects of this insect race.
The swarms of domesticated insects under my command are all descendants of Xiaobai's lineage. "
“But the hinterland of Juewuxu is vast and the Zerg race is prosperous. Xiaobai’s tribe is definitely not the only one with the Soul-Burning Golden Scythe.
In the secret realm, there is also the most tyrannical Burning Soul Gold-eating Cockroach of this clan. Its insect mother has reached the middle level of the Great Sage. She controls most of the Juewu Void insect swarm. She calls herself the Insect King and is extremely domineering. "
"In the past, Juewu had an ancient world source to suppress it, and the space was stable. Even though the Insect King's background was astronomical, he could only be trapped in the secret realm, unable to take even half a step.
However, a group of monks from the Zheng family were greedy and united with greedy people from all sides to forcibly steal and strip away the source of the secret realm, completely breaking the virtual ban of Juewu, causing the Insect King to break free from the confinement with an endless tide of insects and wreak havoc on Qingwu Continent, causing a catastrophe for one party. "
Mo Fan paused slightly, his eyes were solemn, and he solemnly warned the civil and military officials of the court: "You must remember that the Burning Spirit-Eating Golden Cockroach is vicious in nature, gluttonous, and extremely terrifying.
Its carapace is stronger than divine gold and cannot be broken even by bombardment from ordinary ancient treasures.
The mouthpiece condenses the power of pure Geng metal and is unparalleledly sharp. Anything containing spiritual energy, including vegetation, living creatures, monks' bodies, magic weapons, spiritual weapons, and treasures of heaven and earth, can be devoured in an instant and turned into nothingness. "
"A single ferocious insect is already difficult to deal with, but once it gathers into a tide and becomes overwhelming, its power will increase exponentially.
When the number is sufficient, even if a powerful person in the Great Saint Realm is trapped in the sea of insects, he will not be able to escape the end of being eaten to death and his soul will be destroyed! "
“This is definitely not an exaggeration on my part.
Earlier, the Insect King had led an endless swarm of insects to storm the Zheng Family Xuantian Sword City. The bloody battle lasted for half a day and the power was overwhelming.
The Zheng family owns the famous Great Xuantian Sword Formation in the spiritual world, and its foundation is unparalleled. They just barely managed to push back the insect tide.
It's just that I never expected that after the Insect King was dormant and resting, he would cross the border and point his troops directly at our Eternal Imperial Dynasty! "
After a detailed explanation, the atmosphere in the entire Eternal Palace suddenly dropped. A heavy stone weighed on the hearts of all the ministers, and a bit of a chill was felt.
"Hateful! The Zheng family must be behind this!" With red eyes, he was the first to scold angrily.
"That's right! The Zheng family must have a grudge after losing the war. They deliberately leaked the information about our Azure Dragon Territory and framed our dynasty, in order to divert the hatred of the Insect Emperor!" Chatter also gritted his teeth, filled with resentment, "Such insidious tactics are really despicable and shameless!"
In anger, all the courtiers came forward to ask for orders with earnest and determined expressions.
"Emperor, the insect tide is dangerous and disaster is imminent. We cannot sit idly and wait for death!"
"I implore the emperor to immediately mobilize his troops to the north, take the initiative to attack, suppress the insect tide, and protect the territory!"
Although the ministers were wary of the insect swarm in the sky, no one was timid.
